note.original: 渋谷事変への出演はANN（TV 2）のキャスト掲載と作品内容による。声優ja.wikipediaは第2期を一括表記

translations.ko: 시부야 사변 출연은 ANN(TV 2) 캐스트 기재와 작품 내용에 근거. 성우 ja.wikipedia는 2기 일괄 표기
translations.en: Appearance in the Shibuya Incident is based on the ANN (TV 2) cast listing and the story; the VA's ja.wikipedia lists Season 2 as one entry

translations.en: The VA's ja.wikipedia lists Season 2 (Hidden Inventory/Shibuya Incident) as one entry; the Shibuya Incident appearance (feeding Sukuna's fingers to Itadori) is based on the Shibuya Incident arc description in ja.wikipedia 'Jujutsu Kaisen'
